question.text: Will FURA introduce another cultivated meat dish on its menu before July 2027?
question.resolution_criteria: This question will resolve as **Yes** if at any time before July 1, 2027, FURA has at least one item on its menu that contains a cultured meat other than Japanese quail.

research:
**Bottom line:** As of 2026-11-19, FURA's live menu has no cultured meat other than Vow's Forged Japanese quail. Nothing has resolved the question yet. Singapore has approved other cultivated meats (Parima chicken and duck, Aleph beef), but I found no report of FURA, or any Singapore restaurant, serving them.

## 1. Resolution source
- 2026-11-19 (fetched today): fura.space/menu, "Journal of Future Food". The only cultured meat is Forged cultured Japanese quail, used in three items:
  - "A Quail Walks Into a Bar": Forged parfait, $20
  - "Bread & Butter (ish)": Forged tallow, $15
  - "A Quail Walks Into a Martini" cocktail, $25
  Other items marked as future protein are jellyfish ceviche and cricket-garum pumpkin. Other drinks use mealworm and jellyfish. [menu](https://www.fura.space/menu)
- The page has no date stamp and no data file behind it. It is a Squarespace page with static text. I found no more frequent source; FURA's Instagram would be the next thing to watch.

## 2. Current status
- 2026-11-19: Nothing settles the question. The menu matches the April 2026 baseline: quail is the only cultured meat. [menu](https://www.fura.space/menu)

## 3. Recent news (newest first)
- 2026-11-17/18: UPSIDE Foods put cultivated chicken in 8 California restaurants. This is US only and not relevant to Singapore supply. [PETA](https://www.peta.org/lifestyle/food/upside-cultivated-chicken-restaurants/)
- 2026-08-04: Singapore Food Agency (SFA) approved Aleph Farms' Cultivated Thin-Cut Steak, 10-20% cultivated beef cells with a plant base. Launch is targeted for H1 2027 through "select restaurant partners", not yet named, with modest initial volumes. [FoodNavigator](https://www.foodnavigator.com/Article/2026/08/04/cultivated-beef-steak-to-hit-singapore-food-scene-with-historic-approval/)
- 2026-07-23/24: FURA won World's Best Bar at the Spirited Awards, raising its profile and its appeal as a partner for launches. [Forbes](https://www.forbes.com/sites/ginapace/2026/07/24/singapores-fura-named-worlds-best-bar-at-2026-spirited-awards/), [Time Out](https://www.timeout.com/news/singapore-bar-fura-crowned-best-bar-2026-072726)
- 2026-07: Parima produced cultivated duck at multi-tonne scale on a 22,000 L line run by Vow in Sydney. Vow is FURA's existing quail supplier, which is a possible supply link. [Cultivated Meat News roundup](https://cultivated-meat.maubon.com/2026/04/16/parima-gets-singapore-approval-to-sell-lab-grown-duck-under-gourmey-brand/), [Food Ingredients First](https://www.foodingredientsfirst.com/news/parima-secures-regulatory-clearance-to-sell-cultivated-duck-in-singapore.html)
- 2026-04-15: SFA approved Parima's cultivated duck, its second approval after chicken in October 2025. Parima is targeting high-end dining, including foie gras. No restaurant partner or debut date has been named. [FoodNavigator](https://www.foodnavigator.com/Article/2026/04/15/parima-gets-regulatory-approval-for-cultivated-foie-gras/)
- 2026-04-11: The Star says FURA is "heavily invested" in cultivated proteins, but mentions only quail and no plans for additions. Insect dishes needed a 6-month SFA licence. [The Star](https://www.thestar.com.my/lifestyle/living/2026/04/11/singapore-restaurants-bricolage-and-fura-are-building-the-menus-of-the-future)
- 2026 (date unclear): FURA added two new insect items after SFA approved 16 insect species. This shows it quickly adopts newly approved novel foods. [Urban List](https://www.theurbanlist.com/singapore/a-list/best-bars-singapore)
- 2025-03: Volume Two menu kept the quail and added the parfait dish. [Spirits Business](https://www.thespiritsbusiness.com/2025/03/fura-unveils-new-menu/), [Jigger Daily](https://jiggerdaily.com/fura-singapore-cocktail-menu-journal-of-future-foods-volume-two/)

## 4. Base rates
- 2023-10 to 2026-11 (about 37 months): FURA has used only one cultured meat (Vow quail), across at least two menu volumes. Its rate of adding a second cultivated species so far is 0.
- Singapore has had few cultivated meat options for human consumption:
  - Eat Just GOOD Meat chicken (2020), with limited retail
  - Vow quail (2024)
  - Parima chicken (October 2025) and duck (April 2026), not yet visibly on sale
  - Aleph beef (approved August 2026, launch H1 2027)
- Roughly 4-7 months passed between Vow's approval and its quail reaching FURA. That gap is consistent with a possible Parima or Aleph debut before mid-2027, if suppliers pick FURA.
- 2026: one industry roundup says there are close to a dozen cultivated meat approvals worldwide, "none yet selling at scale". [Cultivated X](https://cultivated-x.com/approvals/cultivated-meat-2026-close-dozen-approvals-none-yet-selling-at-scale/)

## 5. Other forecasts
- I found no Polymarket, Kalshi, Manifold or Metaculus market on FURA or on Singapore restaurant launches of cultivated meat.
- The Kalshi markets you supplied (quahog landings, broiler production, EU beef price, Baconator and Crunchwrap prices) do not match this question.

## 6. Upcoming events before resolution (to 2027-06-30)
- H1 2027: Aleph Farms' Singapore launch with restaurant partners still to be announced. Production is at Cell Agritech, Singapore.
- Any time: Parima's restaurant debut of duck or chicken in Singapore (high-end dining), possibly via its link with Vow.
- Possible new FURA menu (Volume Three). I found no sign of one, and past volumes came out roughly yearly (Volume Two in March 2025).
- Further SFA approvals of cultivated meats.
- Annulment risk: I found no sign that FURA is closing.

Sources: [FURA menu](https://www.fura.space/menu), [The Star](https://www.thestar.com.my/lifestyle/living/2026/04/11/singapore-restaurants-bricolage-and-fura-are-building-the-menus-of-the-future), [FoodNavigator Aleph](https://www.foodnavigator.com/Article/2026/08/04/cultivated-beef-steak-to-hit-singapore-food-scene-with-historic-approval/), [FoodNavigator Parima](https://www.foodnavigator.com/Article/2026/04/15/parima-gets-regulatory-approval-for-cultivated-foie-gras/), [Food Ingredients First](https://www.foodingredientsfirst.com/news/parima-secures-regulatory-clearance-to-sell-cultivated-duck-in-singapore.html), [Cultivated Meat News](https://cultivated-meat.maubon.com/2026/04/16/parima-gets-singapore-approval-to-sell-lab-grown-duck-under-gourmey-brand/), [GFI APAC](https://gfi-apac.org/why-singapores-world-first-cultivated-beef-and-duck-approvals-matter/), [Forbes](https://www.forbes.com/sites/ginapace/2026/07/24/singapores-fura-named-worlds-best-bar-at-2026-spirited-awards/), [Time Out](https://www.timeout.com/news/singapore-bar-fura-crowned-best-bar-2026-072726), [Urban List](https://www.theurbanlist.com/singapore/a-list/best-bars-singapore), [Spirits Business](https://www.thespiritsbusiness.com/2025/03/fura-unveils-new-menu/), [Jigger Daily](https://jiggerdaily.com/fura-singapore-cocktail-menu-journal-of-future-foods-volume-two/), [Green Queen](https://www.greenqueen.com.hk/vow-food-singapore-regulatory-approval-cultivated-quail-forged-parfait/), [Cultivated X](https://cultivated-x.com/approvals/cultivated-meat-2026-close-dozen-approvals-none-yet-selling-at-scale/), [PETA](https://www.peta.org/lifestyle/food/upside-cultivated-chicken-restaurants/)

I found no sign that FURA has served any cultured meat other than Japanese quail. The live menu checked today still shows quail as its only cultured meat. The main ways this could change before July 2027 are new approved products from other companies in Singapore: Parima's duck, which could be foie gras, and Aleph Farms' beef steak.

### 1. Resolution source
- 2026-11-19 (fetched today): The FURA menu page ("Journal of Future Food") lists two cultured items, both made from Vow's Japanese quail. One is "A Quail Walks Into A Bar", a Forged parfait of cultured Japanese quail at $20. The other is "A Quail Walks Into A Martini", a cocktail at $25. "Bread & Butter (ish)" uses Forged tallow, a by-product of the same quail process. The other "future protein" items are jellyfish, crickets in a sauce and mealworm in a drink. None of them is a cultured meat other than quail. The page has no "last updated" date, so it may lag the dishes actually being served. [FURA menu](https://www.fura.space/menu)
- There is no data file behind the menu. It is a static Squarespace page.

### 2. Current status
- Nothing has settled the question. Up to today I found no report of FURA serving cultured duck, chicken, beef, fish or pork. [Green Queen](https://www.greenqueen.com.hk/fura-singapore-journal-of-future-food-menu-asias-50-best-bars/)

### 3. Recent news (newest first)
- 2026-11-17/18: UPSIDE Foods is rolling out cultivated chicken in California. This is about the US, not Singapore. [PETA](https://www.peta.org/lifestyle/food/upside-cultivated-chicken-restaurants/)
- 2026-08-04: Singapore's food regulator (SFA) approved Aleph Farms' "Cultivated Thin-Cut Steak". The product is a hybrid of 10-20% cultivated beef cells on a soy and wheat protein base. Aleph is aiming for a launch "with select restaurant partners" in the first half of 2027, with modest volumes at first. Production will run through Cell Agritech in Singapore. No Singapore restaurant partners have been named; Aleph says it is in "active discussions". [Green Queen](https://www.greenqueen.com.hk/aleph-farms-lab-grown-meat-cultivated-beef-singapore-approval-launch/), [AgFunderNews](https://agfundernews.com/aleph-farms-plans-2027-cultivated-beef-launch-in-singapore-after-securing-green-light-from-regulators)
- 2026-07-23/24: FURA was named World's Best Bar at the Spirited Awards, which raises its profile. [Forbes](https://www.forbes.com/sites/ginapace/2026/07/24/singapores-fura-named-worlds-best-bar-at-2026-spirited-awards/)
- 2026-07-02: Parima, the company formed when Gourmey bought Vital Meat, confirmed it produced cultivated duck at tonne scale on Vow's 22,000-litre line. This matters because Vow already supplies FURA. No Singapore restaurant rollout was named. [Green Queen](https://www.greenqueen.com.hk/parima-gourmey-vital-meat-lab-grown-cultivated-production-vow/)
- 2026-04-15: SFA approved Parima's cultivated duck. The article's image caption links it to foie gras, but the text does not confirm that. Parima plans to target "high-end gastronomy" in Singapore, but I found no named venue. [FoodNavigator](https://www.foodnavigator.com/Article/2026/04/15/parima-gets-regulatory-approval-for-cultivated-foie-gras/), [Food Business MEA](https://www.foodbusinessmea.com/parima-secures-second-cultivated-meat-approval-in-singapore-for-duck-product/)
- 2026-04-11: A Star profile describes FURA's cultured quail plus its insect and jellyfish dishes, with no mention of other cultured proteins or plans for them. It also notes that FURA's insect licence took about six months to get. [The Star](https://www.thestar.com.my/lifestyle/living/2026/04/11/singapore-restaurants-bricolage-and-fura-are-building-the-menus-of-the-future)
- 2025-10: SFA approved Parima's cultivated chicken. [Cultivated X](https://cultivated-x.com/approvals/parima-becomes-first-cultivated-meat-company-secure-regulatory-approval-two-species/)
- 2026: I found no new Vow species approval. Vow has experimented with other species, but its only approval is still Japanese quail. [Vegconomist](https://vegconomist.com/organisations-and-brands/vow/)

### 4. Base rates
- 2024-06-07: FURA became the second restaurant to serve Vow's Forged quail. [Forged by Vow](https://www.forgedbyvow.com/the-feed/forged-by-fura) The menu page has a "Since October 2023" note. Since then, over about 2.5 years and at least two menu versions ("Volume Two" came out around March 2025), FURA has used only one cultured meat. [Spirits Business](https://www.thespiritsbusiness.com/2025/03/fura-unveils-new-menu/)
- Cultivated meats approved for sale in Singapore so far:
  - Good Meat chicken (Eat Just), approved 2020, with very limited sales
  - Vow quail (2024)
  - Parima chicken (2025)
  - Parima duck (April 2026)
  - Aleph beef (August 2026)
- Apart from Vow's quail, none of these has a confirmed regular Singapore restaurant presence in 2026. That limits what FURA could actually buy before mid-2027. [Cultivated X](https://cultivated-x.com/approvals/cultivated-meat-2026-close-dozen-approvals-none-yet-selling-at-scale/)
- FURA adopts new protein categories quickly once they are approved. It added insects after SFA approved 16 insect species in 2024, and it served quail early. [Jigger Daily](https://jiggerdaily.com/fura-singapore-cocktail-menu-journal-of-future-foods-volume-two/)

### 5. Other forecasts
- I found no Polymarket, Kalshi, Manifold or Metaculus market on this question. The Kalshi markets that were supplied (quahog landings, broiler production, EU beef price, fast-food prices) have nothing to do with it.

### 6. Upcoming events before resolution
- First half of 2027: Aleph Farms' planned Singapore restaurant launch, depending on Cell Agritech's line being ready. FURA is mostly plant-based, so a hybrid beef steak may fit its concept less well, but no partners are known.
- Any time: Parima's duck or chicken reaching Singapore fine dining. Parima's production runs on Vow's line, which may make it easier for Vow's existing restaurant clients like FURA to get it. That link is my inference; no source says Vow distributes Parima products.
- Possible new FURA menu, a "Volume Three": the last major version came out around March 2025. I found no announced date.
- Possible new SFA approvals, for example cultivated seafood or Vow adding new species. Nothing is announced.
- FURA closing would annul the question. I saw no signs of that; it won a major award in July 2026.

forecasts.reasoning:
(a) About 7.5 months remain (today is 2026-11-19, and forecasts close 2027-06-30). For Yes, FURA's menu must list, at some point before July 1, 2027, at least one item containing a cultured meat other than Vow's Japanese quail. Examples would be Parima's duck or chicken or Aleph's beef.

(b) If nothing changes, the answer is No. The live menu on 2026-11-19 still lists Forged quail as its only cultured meat. That has been true for roughly 2.5 years and at least two menu volumes.

(c) Base rate: FURA has added zero additional cultivated species in about 29 months of serving cultured quail. Across Singapore more broadly, newly approved cultivated meats rarely reach restaurants quickly:
- Parima chicken was approved in October 2025 and has no visible restaurant presence after more than a year.
- GOOD Meat has had very limited sales.

The chance that a particular venue adds a second cultivated species within a given 7-month window is roughly 5-10%.

(d) Evidence for Yes:
- Aleph Farms' beef was approved on 2026-08-04, with a launch targeted for H1 2027 through unnamed "select restaurant partners".
- Parima's duck was approved on 2026-04-15, aimed at high-end gastronomy, and in July 2026 it was produced on Vow's line. Vow is FURA's existing supplier, which is a possible supply link.
- FURA was named World's Best Bar in July 2026, which makes it an attractive launch partner.
- FURA adopts newly approved novel foods quickly, as it did with insects and with quail.

Evidence for No:
- No partners have been named for either Aleph or Parima.
- Cultivated meat launch timelines usually slip, and initial volumes are "modest".
- FURA is a bar with a mostly plant-forward concept, so a hybrid beef steak fits it imperfectly.
- An April 2026 profile of FURA mentions no plans for further cultivated proteins.
- No Volume Three menu has been announced.

(e) No scenario: Aleph's launch slips into late 2027, or it partners with fine-dining restaurants instead. Parima's Singapore rollout stays unannounced. FURA keeps quail as its sole cultured meat.

Yes scenario: Parima or Aleph picks FURA, given its award profile and Vow connection, for a launch collaboration in spring 2027. A cultivated duck parfait or a beef cocktail garnish then appears on a menu update.

(f) I start from about 7%. I move up because there are now two newly approved products with H1 2027 or high-end restaurant targets, a plausible supply link through Vow, and FURA's profile and willingness to experiment. I move down a little for typical launch slippage and for the short window. I end at roughly 13%.

Probability: 13%

(a) About 7.5 months remain, to June 30, 2027. For Yes, FURA's menu must list at least one item containing a cultured meat other than Vow's Japanese quail at some point before July 1, 2027. Candidates include Parima chicken or duck, Aleph beef, or a newly approved species.

(b) Status quo: No. As of 2026-11-19 the menu still shows quail as the only cultured meat, unchanged since the April 2026 baseline.

(c) Base rate: FURA has added no second cultured species in about 37 months, across at least two menu volumes. That gives a monthly hazard near zero, although supply has also been missing. A more general reference class is "a restaurant adds a newly approved novel product within about 8 months of it becoming commercially available." Even for a keen early adopter, that happens perhaps 20-30% of the time, and only if a supply partnership forms. Combining these, I start from a base rate of about 10-15%.

(d) Evidence:
- **For Yes:**
  - Aleph Farms got SFA approval on 2026-08-04 and targets a Singapore restaurant launch in H1 2027 with partners not yet named.
  - Parima's duck was approved on 2026-04-15, and Parima explicitly targets high-end gastronomy.
  - Parima produces on Vow's line (2026-07-02), and Vow is FURA's existing supplier.
  - FURA won World's Best Bar on 2026-07-24, which makes it an attractive launch partner.
  - FURA adopts newly approved novel foods quickly, for example insects.
- **For No:**
  - No partnership has been announced.
  - The Star profile on 2026-04-11 mentioned no plans for other cultured meats.
  - Good Meat chicken has been approved since 2020 and FURA never used it.
  - Aleph's volumes are modest and its timeline could slip past June 2027.
  - Aleph's launch partners may be steak-oriented restaurants rather than a cocktail bar.
  - Parima has named no Singapore venue seven months after approval.
  - New FURA menu volumes come out roughly yearly, and no Volume Three has been announced.

(e) Scenarios:
- **No:** Aleph launches in mid-2027 at a steakhouse or hotel restaurant. Parima's Singapore debut stays limited to a single fine-dining tasting event, and FURA keeps its quail-only menu.
- **Yes:** Through its Vow connection, FURA gets Parima's cultivated duck or foie gras for a new menu or a limited item in spring 2027. Alternatively, it becomes one of Aleph's "select restaurant partners".

(f) I start at roughly 12%. I move up modestly because there are several concrete supply paths (Aleph's H1 2027 window and Parima's link through Vow) and FURA's profile makes it a natural partner. I hold back because there is no announced deal, the window is short, launch timelines tend to slip, and FURA ignored the earlier cultivated chicken option. I end at about 15%.

Probability: 15%

(a) About 7.4 months remain (to 1 July 2027). For Yes, FURA's menu must at some point list at least one item containing a cultured meat other than Japanese quail, for example Parima's duck or chicken, Aleph's beef, or some new approval.

(b) If nothing changed, the answer is No. As of 19 November 2026 the live menu still lists Vow's Forged quail as its only cultured meat.

(c) Base rate: over roughly 37 months (October 2023 to November 2026) and at least two menu volumes, FURA has never added a second cultivated species. More broadly, approved cultivated meats in Singapore rarely reach restaurants quickly:
- Parima chicken was approved in October 2025 and is still not visibly on sale anywhere after 13 months.
- Parima duck was approved in April 2026 and is likewise not on sale after 7 months.

From this I estimate the chance that a specific venue adds a newly available cultivated species within any 7-month window at about 5-10%.

(d) Evidence for Yes:
- August 2026: Aleph Farms' beef was approved, with a Singapore restaurant launch targeted for H1 2027 through partners not yet named.
- July 2026: Parima produced duck at tonne scale on Vow's line, and Vow already supplies FURA.
- July 2026: FURA won World's Best Bar, which makes it an attractive launch partner.
- FURA has a track record of adopting newly approved novel foods quickly: it was an early quail adopter and added insects after their approval.
- April 2026: The Star described FURA as "heavily invested" in cultivated proteins.

Evidence for No:
- The menu is unchanged as of November 2026.
- No partner announcements exist for Parima or Aleph.
- Aleph says volumes will be modest, and cultivated launch timelines tend to slip.
- The Star's April 2026 profile mentioned no plans for additional cultivated proteins.
